# `tanh`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

```text
tanh(expr)
```

Returns the hyperbolic tangent of `expr`, as if computed by
`java.lang.Math.tanh`.

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented |
| Group | `math_funcs` |
| Kind | scalar (function) |
| Added in Spark | 1.4.0 |

| Deterministic | yes |
